C0939.title: Haier Consumer Finance, Duxiaoman, and Meituan Assist Police in Busting Large-Scale 'Anti-Collection' Fraud Case
C0939.summary: Zhengzhou police in Henan, in coordination with multiple regional law enforcement agencies, dismantled a criminal gang centered on 'Zhengzhou BN Legal Consulting Company'. The gang defrauded numerous online micro-loan borrowers under the guise of 'anti-collection, proxy rights protection, and debt optimization', and was linked to an upstream group forging official state documents and seals.

references.title: Haier Consumer Finance Assists Police in Busting Large-Scale 'Anti-Collection' Financial Black-Market Fraud Case (Economic Daily)
